ns2:section.sectionText: Students will explore sports journalism opportunities on campus and in the Champaign-Urbana community. Class will feature guest speakers, including representatives from print and electronic media, as well as opportunities to observe these individuals at work. This class may join a sports broadcasting Discovery class taught by John Paul for tours of UI athletic facilities and local media outlets and group projects. Students would produce content for a class website. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
